sources.title: Apertus-8B-Instruct-2509 model card
sources.evidence: Identifies the 2509 instruction checkpoint and its base model; states nominal 8B scale, Apache-2.0, open weights, decoder-only Transformer, 65,536-token context and tool use. Reopened October 27: the current card still identifies swiss-ai/Apertus-8B-2509 as its base and describes supervised fine-tuning plus QRPO; it provides no separate active-parameter count.

sources.title: Apertus v1 Technical Report, Sections 1, 2.1 and Table 1
sources.evidence: Lists the exact 8B Instruct checkpoint. Describes language-only models and a dense decoder-only Transformer; the 8B configuration has 32 layers, width 4096, MLP width 21504, 32 query/8 KV heads, xIELU, and untied embeddings. Reopened for the parameter re-audit: Table 1 retains the nominal 8B size and the full report does not separately state an active count for this checkpoint.

sources.title: Apertus-8B-Instruct-2509 configuration
sources.evidence: ApertusForCausalLM with 32 layers, xIELU, grouped-query attention, max_position_embeddings 65536 and untied word embeddings. Downloaded from the corresponding raw/main URL. Fresh October 27 configuration fetch confirms the same 131072-token vocabulary and provides no active-parameter specification.

sources.title: Apertus: a fully open, transparent, multilingual language model
sources.evidence: Dated 2 September 2025; explicitly announces release that day and present availability of 8B and 70B models for download. Credits the Swiss AI Initiative led by EPFL and ETH Zurich with CSCS.

sources.title: Developer clarification on thinking in the released 2509 Instruct checkpoints
sources.evidence: The question explicitly names both 8B and 70B Instruct-2509. Swiss AI organization member loleg says the first release should not be labeled a thinking model despite the format's thinking controls.

sources.title: Apertus 1.5 Release Notes
sources.evidence: Later first-party notes identify 8B and 70B Apertus 1.0 and distinguish their successor's added image/audio understanding, optional thinking mode and expanded context. These additions do not describe the 2509 checkpoint.

sources.title: Code of Practice for the Apertus LLM, pages 1–2
sources.evidence: First-party release documentation identifies Apertus family, September 2 2025 release, nominal total sizes 8B/70B, text-only input/output, Apache 2.0 and distribution of both base and instruct models.

sources.title: Entropy in Large Language Models, Table 1
sources.publisher: Marco Scharringhausen / Carl von Ossietzky University of Oldenburg
sources.evidence: Freshly read October 27. This original empirical study names the exact Apertus-8B-Instruct-2509 checkpoint with 8B total parameters, but leaves its separate active-parameters column blank. It therefore corroborates nominal total size without establishing an active count.

sources.title: Apertus v1.5 Technical Report, Section 2.1 and Table I.2
sources.evidence: Freshly read October 27. The successor continues from Apertus 1.0 but adds image/audio inputs and expands the input embedding matrix beyond the original 131072 rows; its size cannot be transferred unchanged to the original checkpoint. Table I.2 explicitly reports active counts only for MoE response models and contains no Apertus row. Original 8B/70B performance comparisons do not add an active count.

sources.title: Kolibri technical report, Tables 28 and 48
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, including the complete PDF text. Table 28 explicitly gives 70B total and active parameters for Apertus 70B Instruct, and Table 48 identifies swiss-ai/Apertus-70B-Instruct-2509. The report does not give an Apertus 8B counterpart, so this original research convention cannot establish the smaller checkpoint's active count.

sources.title: Olmo 3 technical report, original Apertus comparisons
sources.publisher: Allen Institute for AI / Team Olmo
sources.evidence: Freshly read and full text searched October 27. The paper compares Apertus 8B base stages and Apertus 8B Instruct performance, including the Instruct evaluation table, without an explicit activated-parameter count for either. Its active-sampling terminology describes training data selection, not parameter participation.

name.note: Names the exact instruction checkpoint linked by the frozen record; distinct from Apertus 8B base and later v1.5.

developer.note: Catalog shorthand for the Swiss AI Initiative, led by EPFL and ETH Zurich with CSCS.

family.note: The developer explicitly names the Apertus model family.

release_date.note: The dated launch announcement explicitly establishes public availability; release documentation includes both base and instruct variants.

open_weights.note: The developer distributes model weights through its Hugging Face repositories.

license.note: Named model license in the model card and release documentation.

parameters_b.note: Reconfirmed the developer-published nominal total of 8 billion parameters for the exact 2509 instruction checkpoint. Its card explicitly names Apertus-8B-2509 as the base and describes post-training; no exact tensor census is required to retain this published size.

active_parameters_b.note: Searched total and active counts separately, including exact-name active/activated-parameter queries, named base/post-training lineage, and later original comparison papers. No supported active count was found: Entropy Table 1 leaves the exact 8B row blank; Kolibri establishes a convention only for 70B; Olmo 3 provides performance comparisons without an active count. Apertus 1.5 changes modalities and input embeddings. Dense architecture and the nominal total do not independently establish an active value.

architecture.note: Dense decoder-only Transformer with grouped-query attention and xIELU; the report and exact checkpoint configuration agree.

context_window.note: The exact model card and configuration both specify 65,536 tokens.

modalities.note: The original release is text-only; multimodal input is a later v1.5 addition.

reasoning.note: The developer says the 2509 Instruct release should not be labeled a thinking model; template tokens alone do not establish that capability.

tool_call.note: The exact model card explicitly supports tool use; the technical report describes function-calling training data.

description.value: Instruction-tuned multilingual text model from the Swiss AI Initiative, released with Apache-2.0 weights, a 65,536-token context window and tool calling.
description.note: Uses supported capabilities and removes the baseline's unqualified legal-compliance assertion.

patch.name: Apertus 8B Instruct 2509
patch.description: Instruction-tuned multilingual text model from the Swiss AI Initiative, released with Apache-2.0 weights, a 65,536-token context window and tool calling.
patch.notes: The 8B parameter count is the developer's nominal total for Apertus-8B-Instruct-2509. Active parameters are not separately established by the original documentation or later comparisons checked. Apertus 1.5 has a different multimodal vocabulary and checkpoint.

summary: Fresh parameter re-audit preserves the developer-published nominal 8B total and explicitly retains null active parameters after separate original-source and later-comparison searches. The exact 8B entropy-study row leaves active parameters blank; Kolibri's explicit 70B convention does not cover 8B, and Apertus 1.5 changes the architecture. All other twelve audited fields remain unchanged.
